title: Race day for runners – GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON 2026
claims: The 2026 BMW BERLIN-MARATHON takes place on Sunday 27 September 2026.
The start is on Straße des 17. Juni, between the Brandenburg Gate and the 'Kleiner Stern'.
Start times are 8:20 am for top handbikers, 8:26 am for elite wheelchair athletes, 8:29 am for handbike and wheelchair athletes, and runners start from 8:45 am in six waves.
The race takes place regardless of the weather unless a weather warning from the German Weather Service exists; schedule and course are subject to change.
The bib number is valid from 24 to 27 September 2026 as a ticket in fare zones A, B and C.

Public transport stops near the start and finish are U-Bahn Unter den Linden, Brandenburger Tor, Bundestag and Potsdamer Platz; S-Bahn Brandenburger Tor, Berlin Main Station and Potsdamer Platz; regional rail Berlin Main Station and Potsdamer Platz.
The time limit is 6:15 hours and the cut-off point is at 3:40 pm at km 33.
Runners who miss the cut-off or time limit must leave the course and are taken to the finish in the sweep bus; continuing at their own risk is not permitted.
The official finish time is 5:00 pm and crossing the finish line after that is no longer possible.
Start-block admission times run from 7:00 am for blocks A/B/C to 9:00 am for block K, with D/E at 7:30, F/G at 8:00 and H/J at 8:30.
Runner entrances are Platz der Republik for all runners and Bremer Weg only for runners with a purple bib, a poncho symbol and no place in block K.
Own refreshments must be delivered by 7:45 am to Annemarie-Renger-Str. / Otto-von-Bismarck-Allee.
Entry to the start/finish area is limited to participants with an official bib number and athlete wristband.

Accessible parking is limited to vehicles with an official special permit on Altonaer Str. in the direction from Großer Stern toward Hansaplatz, with additional spaces on Fasanenstraße near Charlottenburger Tor.
Massage stations are set up from km 25 every 5 km, with a free massage service after the finish.
Accessible restrooms are available at all refreshment points.
The race-day page warns wheelchair athletes and handcyclists about tram tracks at km 8 and km 38.
The race-day page lists technical support and a dedicated sweep vehicle for wheelchair and handbike athletes.
